name: Stellereum Testnet
_comment: OPERATOR NOTES (strip every key starting with '_' before submitting to ethereum-lists/chains as _data/chains/eip155-5757.json). BLOCKER: Chainlist probes eth_chainId/eth_blockNumber/eth_getBalance, but the live node answers only stell_* (POST /, docs/RPC.md). Do NOT file this PR until the EVM shim on evm.stellereum.org returns 0x167d for eth_chainId (handoff doc EVM_CHAINLIST_PR.md section 2, steps 1-2). Until then rpc[0] is a placeholder for the future shim endpoint and rpc[1] (pure stell_*) is TEMPORARY: if rpc.stellereum.org still does not answer eth_* at PR time, drop rpc[1] and submit rpc[0] alone, otherwise Chainlist flags the endpoint dead. decimals=9 is ledger truth: 1 STELL = 1_000_000_000 nano (src/tokenomics.rs TOTAL_SUPPLY_CAP, src/pmm.rs, MIN_VALIDATOR_BOND = 1000*1e9 in src/staking.rs). The handoff doc proposes decimals=18 as EVM-presentation with 9<->18 conversion inside the future EVM shim; revisit this field when the shim lands, do not change the ledger. NO CONTRACT EXECUTION over RPC: there is no eth_call equivalent and no contract-call method on the public surface (contracts deploy on-chain via WASM/SVM but are not callable via RPC); batch request arrays are refused (-32600, send requests individually); transport is POST-only to /, bodies over 1 MiB are rejected; stell_sendRawTransaction is write-gated by STELL_RPC_AUTH_TOKEN. redFlags is intentionally omitted: 5757 is presumed free, but the operator MUST verify with grep for '"chainId": 5757' and '"shortName": "stell-t"' in a fresh ethereum-lists/chains clone before filing; on collision, change chainId (consensus change, out of scope here), do not file silently with reusedChainId. faucets=[] because the RPC faucet is token-gated and fail-closed (STELL_FAUCET_TOKEN, docs/RPC.md section 4), not a passwordless public faucet in the Chainlist sense; the public web faucet at https://faucet.stellereum.org is a candidate entry only after the operator confirms it needs no token. icon intentionally omitted (needs a chainIcons asset plus an icon field; file as a second PR). Live-verified 2026-10-14: stell_chainId -> 5757, stell_getValidators returns {validators:[{validator,power}],total_power,quorum} plus extra fragile/fragile_reason fields consumers must ignore; power values are decimal strings in nano-STELL.
_temporary_rpc_fallback: TEMPORARY (do not submit as-is): until public DNS/TLS for rpc.stellereum.org is live, operators may expose the node via a TLS-terminating proxy only (never bare http://<ip>:8545; Chainlist requires https with no trailing slash and no port). Append that https URL here while testing, remove before filing unless it answers eth_*.
_strip_before_pr: Remove all top-level keys starting with '_' (_comment, _temporary_rpc_fallback, _strip_before_pr). Validate the remainder with: python3 -m json.tool _data/chains/eip155-5757.json
